title: Leave a usable terminal after piped installation
when: Interrupting setup or resuming a suspended installer pipeline
need: The piped installer gives setup /dev/tty input. Ctrl-C quits setup; foreground resume after SIGTSTP restores its display. Mouse reporting and terminal settings must be restored before returning to the shell.
surface: Public shell installer and setup TUI
gap: No remaining terminal-proof gap under the approved combination of Terminal.app visible interruption and POSIX PTY suspend/resume tests.
review: Independent review accepted released launch.625 curl-pipe-sh interruption in Terminal.app: a readable shell returned and persistent termios matched. Only Darwin PENDIN retype-pending-input state was masked; paired transcript supplied values covered by a capture-helper window. POSIX regression additionally proves foreground ownership, the real setup driver and quit binding, SIGTSTP/fg, mouse-mode cleanup and exact stty restoration with stubbed installation side effects. The suspend test waits for the setup process to stop before fg; a delayed stop exercises scheduling where the shell prompt appears first.
